rationale: Eliminates the cash deficit by compressing the early Carrot bootstrap to a single cycle harvested on Day 3 morning, immediately transitioning 100% of acreage on Days 3-4 to hyper-fertilized Strawberries to secure 7-8 recurring harvest flushes instead of 5-6. Reverses the fatal 14-item hoarding trap of Generations 80-82 by recalibrating uncontracted surplus liquidation to trigger at >= 6 items with a dedicated 4-item high-value shed buffer for immediate 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop arbitrage, preventing market price collapse and daytime cash starvation. Abolishes rigid backpack gating in favor of opportunistic drop-offs (>= 6 items), completely bans slow single-harvest crops, and enforces a strict 22-24 plot land cap frozen at Day 12-13 alongside a Day 22 seed procurement freeze.
